in_marathi.name: Purnika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purnika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'purna' which means 'full' and 'ika' meaning 'one'. Purnika is the name of the goddess Parvati who is symbolized by the full moon. It represents the fullness of life and the cycle of birth, growth, and transformation.
